name: Slack 私聊（我的账号）
description: 收别人发给你本人的 Slack 私聊，变成 Gerdr 事件；回复以你本人的身份发出。不用建 app，用你在 Slack 桌面版的登录（要装 slackctl）。

emits.title: Slack 有人私聊我
emits.description: 别人发给你的私信（含群私聊，可在设置里关掉）

emits.title: Slack 频道里 @ 了我
emits.description: 频道里有人 @ 你（要在设置里打开）

settings.title: 工作区
settings.description: 从哪个工作区收（地址或名字的一部分，比如 longbridge-pe）。空着 = slackctl 的默认工作区。企业版里私聊是全组织共享的，连一个就够。

settings.title: 群私聊也收
settings.description: 几个人的私聊（不是频道）也发成 slack-me/direct。

settings.title: 频道里 @ 我也收
settings.description: 频道里 @ 你的消息发成 slack-me/mention。

settings.title: 只收这些人的消息
settings.description: Slack 用户 ID（U0XXXX），逗号分隔。空着 = 谁的都收。

settings.title: 附件大小上限
settings.description: 消息里的图片、文件下到本机，路径放进事件。0 = 不下。

settings.title: slackctl 路径
settings.description: 空着 = 在 PATH 和 ~/go/bin、/opt/homebrew/bin 里找。

en.name: Slack DMs (my account)
en.description: Direct messages people send you on Slack become Gerdr events; replies are sent as you. No Slack app: it uses your Slack desktop sign-in (needs slackctl).

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.description: Which workspace to listen on (part of its address or name, e.g. longbridge-pe). Empty = slackctl's default. On Enterprise Grid DMs are org-wide, so one is enough.

groupDMs.title: Group DMs too
groupDMs.description: Multi-person DMs (not channels) also become slack-me/direct.

mentions.title: @-mentions in channels
mentions.description: Channel messages that @-mention you become slack-me/mention.

allow.title: Only from these people
allow.description: Slack user IDs (U0XXXX), comma separated. Empty = everyone.

maxFileMB.title: Attachment size limit
maxFileMB.description: Images and files are downloaded and their paths put in the event. 0 = don't.
